enum.name: CREATE
enum.description: Permission to create a new entity or resource.

enum.name: READ
enum.description: Permission to read or view the entity or resource.

enum.name: UPDATE
enum.description: Permission to modify or update the entity or resource.

enum.name: DELETE
enum.description: Permission to delete the entity or resource.

enum.name: CHANGE_PERMISSIONS
enum.description: Permission to change access permissions for the entity or resource.

enum.name: DOWNLOAD
enum.description: Permission to download files or data from the entity or resource.

enum.name: UPLOAD
enum.description: Deprecated. Adding this to an ACL will do nothing.

enum.name: PARTICIPATE
enum.description: Permission to participate in activities related to the entity, such as discussions or challenges.

enum.name: SUBMIT
enum.description: Permission to submit content or data to the entity or resource.

enum.name: READ_PRIVATE_SUBMISSION
enum.description: Permission to read private submissions associated with the entity.

enum.name: UPDATE_SUBMISSION
enum.description: Permission to update or modify a submission.

enum.name: TEAM_MEMBERSHIP_UPDATE
enum.description: Permission to update team membership, such as adding or removing members.

enum.name: SEND_MESSAGE
enum.description: Permission to send messages related to the entity or resource.

enum.name: CHANGE_SETTINGS
enum.description: Permission to change settings or configuration for the entity or resource.

enum.name: MODERATE
enum.description: Permission to moderate content or activity related to the entity or resource.

enum.name: REVIEW_SUBMISSIONS
enum.description: Allows to review a group of submissions (e.g. on ARs) for a given object

enum.name: EXEMPTION_ELIGIBLE
enum.description: Eligible for exemption when granted this permission on the ACl of the AR
